basis: A neurologic movement disorder defined by recurrent kinesigenic dyskinesia, chorea and dystonia.
Inherited left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy; no supported extracardiac involvement.
Osteochondrosis of the patellar tendon attachment to the patella.
Dipteran larval infestation; anatomical sites vary across this umbrella, with no particular organ established as affected in most patients.
Schwann-cell-derived nerve sheath neoplasm. Skin, oral and other anatomical sites vary; none warrants an additional umbrella label.
Nonsyndromic X-linked intellectual developmental disorder.
Benign mesenchymal soft-tissue neoplasm; no cardiac or other specific organ of origin is established for this generic concept.
Inherited amyloid disorder with corneal dystrophy and neuropathy; skin disease 80-99%. Hearing, salivary and cardiac involvement omitted by cap; renal series are too small to establish prevalence.
Focal developmental malformation of the cerebral cortex.
Defined by digital skeletal malformations and microcephaly; seizures support neurologic involvement. Diabetes frequency is unspecified.
A young-onset Parkinson disease subtype affecting the central nervous system.
Hepatic disease is explicitly defining. Cyanosis alone does not establish cardiac, pulmonary or blood disease; further characterization is absent.
Osteomyelitis of the petrous temporal bone. Adjacent ear or cranial nerve damage is not established as common within this concept.
Alpha-thalassemia and intellectual developmental impairment define ATR-16; skeletal malformations include clubfoot in 8/8 and pectus carinatum in 30-79%.
Immune system disorder defined by deficient cytokine receptor activity; no specific organ damage is established.
Mitochondrial disorder with pancreatic insufficiency and dyserythropoietic anemia; defining calvarial hyperostosis and osteopenia occur in 3/5. Asthma is a separate disease.
Early-onset cataract confined to the anterior polar region of the lens.
Defined by hair and nail dysplasia plus hypodontia and abnormal teeth. Hearing, hip and respiratory involvement lack evidence of common occurrence.
Defined by hypothalamic-pituitary endocrine dysfunction, hypogonadism and growth hormone deficiency with neurodevelopmental impairment.
Intellectual disability and limb defects define the syndrome; auditory canal atresia and dental/palatal abnormalities are annotated at 80-99%. Hirsutism does not establish skin damage.
Obstetric pregnancy outcome without a defined disease of an organ covered by the axes.
Structural tricuspid valve disease causing leaflet prolapse and possible regurgitation.
Defining renal hypoplasia/aplasia and middle-ear ossicular anomalies with hearing impairment; vaginal atresia has no axis.
C1-inhibitor deficiency with defining subcutaneous and intestinal angioedema. Laryngeal attacks cause episodic edema rather than usual lasting airway damage.
Inherited erythroid marrow failure with macrocytic anemia and reticulocytopenia. Cardiac and developmental abnormalities have no established qualifying frequency.
